acceptance: A run without --keep leaves its rows in .evolve/agent-runs/llm-calls.ndjson with the run label.
A second import of the same run adds no row.
An import failure warns and does not change the exit code of the run.
fix: Before removeWorkspace, import the run workspace llm-calls.ndjson into .evolve/agent-runs/llm-calls.ndjson with llmcalls.Import, and tag each row with the run label and the profile. Do not change launchrecord (fence).
